display_name: Coastwide Professional Heavy-Duty Cleaner and Degreaser Power Clean Concentrate for ExpressMix, 3.25L, 2/Carton
regulatory_class: EPA-regulated chemical product - heavy-duty alkaline cleaner and degreaser
claim_policy_note: BLOCKING RULE. This is a regulated chemical. Every visible word must come from approved_source_strings below, from Staples' own published art for that shot, or from an explicitly declared placeholder - and each shot states which via its `text_provenance` field. No new safety, performance, efficacy, dilution, surface-compatibility or certification claim may be authored, inferred or strengthened. No text or graphic element may be placed on or over the bottle label.

text_provenance_policy._note: Added in v1.1 after Pratyoosh authorized placeholder copy for this internal POC. Provenance is tracked per shot so that 'which words are really Staples' words' is answerable at any time without re-reading the briefs.
text_provenance_policy.APPROVED: Verbatim from the creative brief or the Asset Tracker's live marketplace copy. Fully defensible.
text_provenance_policy.PUBLISHED_ART: Verbatim from Staples' own finished production image for that shot. Approved - they published it - but not evidenced in any document in this folder. Defensible, with provenance noted.
text_provenance_policy.PLACEHOLDER_POC: Written by InfoVision to unblock a shot. Internal POC only. Every instance carries a `placeholder_declaration` block and MUST be listed in manifest.json and in the package README.
text_provenance_policy.lint_behavior: The claim lint validates APPROVED and PUBLISHED_ART strings against their sources as normal. PLACEHOLDER_POC strings bypass source validation but are recorded, counted, and surfaced in the run summary - they are never silently blessed.
text_provenance_policy.hard_limit_on_placeholders: A placeholder may not state a quantified promise or a regulated instruction: no dilution ratio, no application distance, no contact time, no kill claim, no certification, no refund period, no warranty term. Those are the elements that cause real harm if a demo screenshot escapes the room. Generic reassurance is fine; a specific number is not.

model_number_discrepancy.resolution_applied: CW020EM03-B is used. It matches the Asset Tracker, the live marketplace listing, and both packaging-artwork filenames. The brief value looks like a vendor/print job number (the label files are prefixed 630800-67CWPR), not the model.

shots.purpose: Flat reproduction of the regulatory back label so buyers can read ingredients, warnings and directions.
shots.text_provenance: NONE - the supplied label artwork is placed as-is; no text is authored
shots.blocker: This image IS the regulatory label. It cannot be generated, redrawn, re-typeset or approximated - doing so would be modifying a chemical product label, which the Coastwide style guide explicitly prohibits without brand and compliance approval. The only lawful way to produce it is to place the supplied label artwork ('630800-67CWPR-L11966_CW020EM03-B_PowerClnrDgrsr_Bottle Label.ai/.pdf') onto a white canvas at the correct scale.
shots.how_to_unblock: Implement as a straight asset passthrough: rasterize the supplied label PDF at 300dpi, place centered on a white RT_SECONDARY_SQUARE canvas, no text added. This is a legitimate shot to enable - it is disabled here only because it needs no AI at all and is therefore a poor use of demo time. Enable it if a complete 8-shot stack matters more than demo narrative.
